about_the_game:
The world of Elvarn is on the brink of collapse. Long ago, reckless experiments shattered the elemental balance, plunging the land into chaos. To protect what remained, four elemental temples—Fire, Water, Earth, and Wind—were built in a transitional dimension. At their heart lies the ancient cores, fragments of Ugnis’ light, the only force keeping destruction at bay.

You play as Zekke, a young artificer armed with a rune-forged gauntlet that summons living avatars of each element. Inside each temple, you’ll face a series of handcrafted, room-based puzzles that challenge your logic, timing, and creativity. Master each element’s unique abilities, switch between Zekke and his summoned avatars, and outwit the traps and constructs left behind by the Architects.

Every completed temple restores part of the Sacred Pillar of Elvarn, slowly rebuilding the structure that maintains stability in the fractured world. But the Architects’ minions will do everything in their power to stop you.

Features

  • Command Four Elemental Avatars – Fire burns obstacles, Water manipulates flow, Earth shifts weight, Wind controls movement.

  • Strategic Dual Control – Position Zekke and switch between him and his avatars to solve complex puzzles.

  • Room-by-Room Challenges – Every room is a unique puzzle that builds on the mechanics you’ve learned.

  • Four Distinct Temples – Explore visually striking environments inspired by each element.

  • Progressive World Restoration – Watch the Sacred Pillar rebuild itself as you reclaim each temple’s core.
